# Saga Thesis Snapshot — All Evidence

Consolidated fresh continuous thesis rerun evidence. Labels: `fresh-comparison-20260518-121930`, `fresh-scalability-20260518-121930`, `fresh-resilience-20260518-121930`.

Read top to bottom: executive overview, choreography vs orchestration comparison, business correctness, scalability pressure, resilience recovery, compensation, runtime corroboration, resource evidence, then evidence health.

panels.title: Business Terminal Ratio
panels.description: Counter-derived ratio: (completed + cancelled) / started.

options.content:
## Executive thesis verdict

The clean evidence set is structured to answer whether choreography and orchestration differ under identical workload phases. The thesis-facing interpretation should be made from three layers shown below: client-observed k6 outcomes, service-side application metrics, and independent telemetry corroboration from traces, Beyla, process, and container metrics. Positive speedup and p95-reduction panels mean choreography outperformed orchestration for the selected scenario; correctness panels verify that those performance claims were not produced by lost business terminals.

panels.title: Observed Clean Suite Coverage
panels.description: Expected coverage: comparison has baseline/failure phases, scalability covers gradual-rampup and contention, and resilience separates failure injection from successful-order recovery.

targets.expr: count by (suite_label) (sum by (suite_label, pattern, scenario, run_label) (max_over_time(k6_iterations_total{suite_label=~"fresh-comparison-20260518-121930|fresh-scalability-20260518-121930|fresh-resilience-20260518-121930"}[$__range])))

count by (suite_label, pattern) (sum by (suite_label, pattern, scenario, run_label) (max_over_time(k6_iterations_total{suite_label=~"fresh-comparison-20260518-121930|fresh-scalability-20260518-121930|fresh-resilience-20260518-121930"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Throughput Speedup by Scenario
panels.description: Values above 1.0 mean choreography reached higher peak journey throughput for the same scenario.

panels.title: P95 Latency Reduction by Scenario
panels.description: Positive values mean choreography has lower client-observed p95 latency.

panels.title: P95 Latency Delta by Scenario
panels.description: Positive milliseconds mean orchestration p95 was slower than choreography.

panels.title: Comparison Throughput and Client Latency Over Time
panels.description: Shared time axis for peak-rate context and latency shape.

panels.title: Terminal Outcome Matrix by Suite, Pattern, and Scenario
panels.description: Counter-derived terminal ratio is included so saturation or failed phases cannot be hidden by a later clean success sample.

targets.expr: (sum by (suite_label, pattern, scenario, run_label) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_completed_total{suite_label=~"$suite_label",pattern=~"$pattern",scenario=~"$scenario",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__range])) + sum by (suite_label, pattern, scenario, run_label) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_cancelled_total{suite_label=~"$suite_label",pattern=~"$pattern",scenario=~"$scenario",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__range]))) / clamp_min(sum by (suite_label, pattern, scenario, run_label) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_started_total{suite_label=~"$suite_label",pattern=~"$pattern",scenario=~"$scenario",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__range])), 1)

(sum by (suite_label, pattern, scenario) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_completed_total{suite_label=~"$suite_label",pattern=~"$pattern",scenario=~"$scenario",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__interval])) + sum by (suite_label, pattern, scenario) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_cancelled_total{suite_label=~"$suite_label",pattern=~"$pattern",scenario=~"$scenario",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__interval]))) / clamp_min(sum by (suite_label, pattern, scenario) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_started_total{suite_label=~"$suite_label",pattern=~"$pattern",scenario=~"$scenario",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__interval])), 1)

panels.title: Started, Completed, Cancelled, Failed, Timed Out
Outcome Match and Terminal Success by Phase
Journey-to-HTTP Efficiency
panels.description: Shows completed journeys per HTTP request for scalability phases. This avoids VU metrics because k6_vus is unlabeled in this evidence set, so labeled k6_vus queries return no data.

targets.expr: sum by (pattern, scenario) (max_over_time(rate(k6_iterations_total{suite_label="fresh-scalability-20260518-121930",scenario=~"gradual-rampup|contention",pattern=~"$pattern",run_label=~"$run_label"}[1m])[$__range:])) / clamp_min(sum by (pattern, scenario) (max_over_time(rate(k6_http_reqs_total{suite_label="fresh-scalability-20260518-121930",scenario=~"gradual-rampup|contention",pattern=~"$pattern",run_label=~"$run_label"}[1m])[$__range:])), 0.001)

(sum by (pattern, scenario) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_completed_total{suite_label="fresh-scalability-20260518-121930",scenario=~"gradual-rampup|contention",pattern=~"$pattern",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__interval])) + sum by (pattern, scenario) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_cancelled_total{suite_label="fresh-scalability-20260518-121930",scenario=~"gradual-rampup|contention",pattern=~"$pattern",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__interval]))) / clamp_min(sum by (pattern, scenario) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_started_total{suite_label="fresh-scalability-20260518-121930",scenario=~"gradual-rampup|contention",pattern=~"$pattern",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__interval])), 1)

panels.title: Scalability Phase Matrix
panels.description: Breaks out gradual rampup and contention rather than reducing scalability to a single aggregate.

panels.title: Resilience Phase Outcome Matrix
panels.description: Keeps failure phases and successful-order recovery phases visible in the same table.

targets.expr: (sum by (pattern, scenario, run_label) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_completed_total{suite_label="fresh-resilience-20260518-121930",pattern=~"$pattern",scenario=~"$scenario",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__range])) + sum by (pattern, scenario, run_label) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_cancelled_total{suite_label="fresh-resilience-20260518-121930",pattern=~"$pattern",scenario=~"$scenario",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__range]))) / clamp_min(sum by (pattern, scenario, run_label) (max_over_time(k6_saga_orders_started_total{suite_label="fresh-resilience-20260518-121930",pattern=~"$pattern",scenario=~"$scenario",run_label=~"$run_label"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Framework Compensation Lifecycle
panels.description: Uses framework compensation counters when available.

panels.title: Application Completed, Failed, and Compensation Rates
Framework Step Latency P95
panels.description: Orchestration framework step latency when the metric is emitted.

panels.title: Optional cAdvisor CPU Cgroup Corroboration
panels.description: Optional host/Docker cgroup corroboration from cAdvisor. This uses exported cgroup id labels and is not per-saga-service container evidence; use the service-level process CPU/memory panels above as the main saga resource evidence.

panels.title: Optional cAdvisor Memory Cgroup Corroboration
panels.description: Optional host/Docker cgroup corroboration from cAdvisor. This uses exported cgroup id labels and is not per-saga-service container evidence; use the service-level process CPU/memory panels above as the main saga resource evidence.

panels.title: Beyla Outbound HTTP Dependencies
panels.description: Beyla outbound dependency evidence from HTTP client metrics, showing service-to-service calls such as order service -> inventory /api/catalog. Inbound API/server activity is separated in the evidence index panel.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (service_name, http_request_method, http_route, server_address) (increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job="beyla",server_address!~".*(alloy|signoz-otel-collector).*"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Tempo, Beyla, and Pyroscope Evidence Index
panels.description: Keeps trace-derived calls/rates, Tempo span latency, Beyla inbound API activity, Beyla outbound dependency evidence, and Pyroscope profiling-ingestion evidence visible in the static public snapshot.

targets.expr: topk(20, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name!~"sql.conn.reset_session|sql.rows"}[5m]))))
topk(20, sum by (service_name, http_request_method, http_route, server_address) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="beyla",http_route!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range])))

panels.title: k6 Remote-Write Receiver Activity
panels.description: 2xx write traffic indicates Prometheus accepted k6 remote-write samples during the capture window.

panels.title: Clean Label Presence
panels.description: The three clean rerun labels should appear here for the focused snapshot.

panels.title: Telemetry Target Health
panels.description: Expected observability and application scrape targets during capture. Optional scaled orchestration replica ports are intentionally not referenced.

panels.title: Stale-Label Guard
panels.description: Large values mean the selected label is historical rather than active in the current time range.

panels.title: Evidence Completeness Checklist
panels.description: If a row is empty, that evidence path is not available for the selected public snapshot window.
